The '''Convergence Tactical Assault Vehicle''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was developed during the [[Republic Dark Age]].

==Description==
The design of the Convergence Tactical Assault Vehicle combined different elements from thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of military science to create a craft that could fulfill many different roles. Twice the size of a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], they were [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]-capable and could be used as [[Transport/Legends|transports]], with space onboard for eight to ten warriors. They also sported weapons systems, allowing them to be used as starfighters, or as [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]].

==History==
The Convergence Vehicle was developed by [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] that served the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]], in the [[Daimanate Dynamic Testing Facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]]. They constructed a prototype version, the [[Convergence (starship)|''Convergence'']], which was fitted with a testing arm that allowed the simulation of sublight conditions. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the Sith Lord [[Odion]] sent the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Narsk Ka'hane]] to infiltrate the Daimanate Testing Facility and steal a copy of the Convergence designs, and the agent successfully obtained a copy of the blueprints. However, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] destroyed his copy of the plans, and detonated some explosives that Ka'hane had placed aboard the ''Convergence'' prototype.
